biography: Axcil Jefferies, a Zimbabwean racing prodigy, wasn't born into motorsport royalty. His journey began on the dusty karting tracks of Harare, fueled by a hand-me-down kart and an unwavering passion. He honed his skills, often competing against much older, more experienced drivers. A defining moment came at the age of 16 when, against all odds, he won the African Karting Championship, earning him a scholarship to a European racing academy. Though successful in formula racing, Jefferies found his true calling in GT racing, attracted by the strategic depth and team dynamics. He currently leads the charge for Cacti Green, a team known for nurturing underdog talent, striving to consistently prove his worth amongst giants.
drivingStyle: Jefferies is a master of defensive driving, a trait honed from years of battling against superior machinery. He's incredibly precise with his braking points and corner entries, prioritizing consistency over outright aggression. He's known for his exceptional tire management, often extending his stints further than his rivals. While not the flashiest driver, he's remarkably adept at soaking up pressure, rarely cracking under the weight of expectation.

rivalries.reason: Villanova, a renowned hothead, has repeatedly accused Jefferies of overly cautious driving, sparking heated on-track battles and post-race confrontations.
Rossi and Jefferies have a tactical rivalry, often found battling for strategic positions in endurance races, each trying to outsmart the other with their pit stop timing.

Tanaka, representing a rival manufacturer, has a long-standing feud with Jefferies regarding car development philosophies and publically stating 'his driving style does not push the car to its limits'.

quirks: Always wears a lucky wristband given to him by his grandmother before every race.
Studies the track map intensely, visualizing every corner and braking point at least five times before getting in the car.
Refuses to eat anything containing tomatoes on race day, believing it brings bad luck.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't just about speed, it's about endurance, strategy, and heart. It's about finding the limit and knowing when to hold back."
careerHighlight: Winning the Spa 24 Hours with Cacti Green in 2028, a monumental achievement for the underdog team, solidifying his status as a GT racing force.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final hour of the Bathurst 12 Hour in 2026 due to a mechanical failure, costing him and his team a certain victory.
